notes: Presentation copy only; not a rules source. Preserve previously pinned campaigns and class definitions.
Starting screen shows base classes only; prestige classes appear in advancement after eligibility checks.
Verify descriptions when mechanics change; do not imply unimplemented world systems or deities.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: A relentless warrior who burns limited rage to hit harder and survive brutal exchanges. Reckless and resilient paths offer different offensive and defensive trade-offs.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: A charismatic performer who bolsters allies with sustained songs and disrupts enemies with hostile verses. Spontaneous magic and limited performance resources reward good timing.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A prepared divine spellcaster who heals wounds, protects allies and channels sacred energy. Excels at answering danger with the right prayers and controlled battlefield support.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: A guardian of nature who prepares restorative and controlling spells, follows a chosen bond and can assume a bear's form. Blends spellcasting with practical battlefield adaptability.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A disciplined combatant who specialises in blades, bows or protective techniques. Weapon choices, feats and finite resolve shape distinctly offensive or defensive fighting styles.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: An unarmoured martial artist who strings together unarmed strikes and spends limited ki on specialised techniques. Careful positioning and resource management matter as much as speed.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A steadfast warrior who smites selected foes, heals by touch and protects the party through divine grace. Combines armed combat with limited healing and protective power.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A wilderness specialist who chooses a quarry and fighting style before developing nature magic. Excels at focused weapon pressure and practical tracking rather than raw spell power.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A versatile expert who exploits openings created by allies to land precise weapon attacks. Special talents can hinder an exposed opponent or help escape trouble.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: An instinctive arcane caster whose bloodline and permanently learned spells define each build. Casts familiar magic without preparing individual copies, but choices carry lasting weight.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: An intelligent spellcaster who plans a prepared repertoire and specialises in an arcane school. Rewards foresight, spell selection and well-timed control or protection.

classes.name: Duelist
classes.description: A prestige fencing specialist focused on precise weapon technique and personal defence. Suits an experienced combatant who prefers timing and elegant exchanges over brute strength.

classes.name: Eldritch Knight
classes.description: A prestige warrior-mage who continues a chosen arcane casting tradition while improving martial capability. Its strength is combining weapons and spells within one build.

classes.name: Arcane Trickster
classes.description: A prestige infiltrator who mixes arcane magic with opportunistic, precision-focused combat. Rewards careful positioning, well-chosen spells and exploiting openings rather than direct confrontation.

classes.name: Mystic Theurge
classes.description: A prestige caster who advances one existing arcane and one divine tradition independently. Gains broad spell access and specialised restoration or protection, without sharing the two spell pools.

classes.name: Psion
classes.description: A psychic specialist whose chosen focus shapes the powers learned. Spend a shared pool of power points and augment individual effects when greater impact justifies the cost.

classes.name: Psychic Warrior
classes.description: A martial psychic who spends a smaller power-point reserve to enhance the body and empower attacks. Trades a full psionic repertoire for practical battlefield presence.

classes.name: Soulknife
classes.description: A psychic fighter who shapes a mental blade, charges it with focus and can throw it at nearby threats. Focus is finite and requires deliberate recovery.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: An occult invoker who unleashes repeatable eldritch attacks and chooses control or concealment techniques. Powers need no spell slots, but still spend actions and face counters.

classes.name: Scout
classes.description: A mobile combatant whose repositioning opens opportunities for skirmish damage. Rewards crossing the battlefield and choosing attack angles rather than remaining stationary.

classes.name: Swashbuckler
classes.description: A lightly equipped finesse fighter who spends resolve on skilful strikes that weaken foes or create protection. Favors quick, well-timed exchanges over heavy armour.

classes.name: Knight
classes.summary: Hold the line for your allies
classes.description: A protective warrior who challenges threats and uses a shared reaction to defend companions. Particularly effective when positioning matters and allies need a reliable front line.

classes.name: Warblade
classes.description: A tactical swordmaster who shifts between offensive and defensive stances, breaches enemy guard and prepares responses to nearby misses. Special manoeuvres use recoverable readiness.

classes.name: Shadowdancer
classes.description: A prestige combatant who uses shadowy shrouds and movement-based disruption to make physical attacks less reliable. Focuses on concealment and control, not unrestricted teleportation.

classes.name: Dragon Disciple
classes.description: A prestige path that develops draconic traits, natural protection and fiery breath. New bodily capabilities do not erase the character's original ancestry or history.

classes.name: Dwarven Defender
classes.description: A prestige protector who anchors a defensive stance to gain resistance and stronger protection. The price of holding firm is severely limited movement.

classes.name: Pyrokineticist
classes.description: A prestige psychic specialist who turns existing power points into flame-based attacks and pressure. Trades broad flexibility for a distinctive command of fire.

classes.name: Crusader
classes.description: A battle-tested guardian whose successful strikes can support allies and whose techniques reinforce nearby companions. Readiness returns during battle or through deliberate recovery.

classes.name: Swordsage
classes.description: A precise martial adept who alternates flowing and fiery stances, disrupts enemies and prepares afterimage defences. Meditation restores technique readiness at a tactical cost.

classes.name: Wilder
classes.description: An intuitive psychic who pushes powers past safer limits for greater effect. Surges invite self-weakening consequences, creating a constant choice between impact and restraint.

classes.name: Binder
classes.description: An occult warrior who commits to an enduring spirit covenant, favouring ember-driven offence or sentinel protection. Covenant actions draw from a rest-limited pool.

classes.name: Warshaper
classes.description: A prestige specialist who draws strength from an altered physical form and its natural attacks. Success depends on the active body, its reach and compatible equipment.

classes.name: Bonded Summoner
classes.description: A prestige specialist built around an existing summoned companion. Its usefulness comes from coordinating a separate ally and managing the limits of that bond.

classes.name: Ardent
classes.description: A philosophical manifester whose chosen mantles shape accessible powers. Wisdom-guided abilities favour distinctive combinations of perception, protection and restorative support.

classes.name: Lurk
classes.description: A psychic infiltrator who combines limited power points, concealment and precise melee opportunities. Prefers a carefully prepared opening over sustained head-on combat.

classes.name: Cerebremancer
classes.description: A prestige hybrid who advances an existing arcane casting tradition alongside psychic manifesting. Offers two separate magical toolkits to a carefully qualified character.

classes.name: Beast Steward
classes.description: A prestige companion specialist who develops one established animal partnership through training and deliberate commands. The bonded creature has its own identity and battlefield role.

classes.name: Erudite
classes.description: A learned psychic with access to many powers but only a limited number of distinct identities per rest. Rewards adapting a deep repertoire to each expedition.

classes.name: Divine Mind
classes.description: A protective psychic whose chosen mantle shapes nearby aura effects and learned powers. Switching support modes costs time and resources; position determines who benefits.

classes.name: Marshal
classes.description: A battlefield leader who strengthens companions through local auras, rallies and limited tactical orders. Suits a party that benefits from coordinated positioning.

classes.name: Cognition Adept
classes.description: A prestige fighter trained to combine precise weapon strikes with psychic wards and learned powers. Focuses on identifying and overcoming dangerous adversaries.

classes.name: Beguiler
classes.description: A spontaneous intelligence-based caster who deceives perception and alters enemy options. Prefers clever disabling effects and protective misdirection over straightforward damage.

classes.name: Dragonfire Adept
classes.description: An elemental invoker who repeatedly unleashes chosen breath attacks, favouring focused reach or wider bursts. Later invocations add protection and battlefield control.

classes.name: War Chanter
classes.summary: Turn battle into a rallying chorus
classes.description: A prestige battlefield performer whose wider war chorus and finite rally power support the company. Brings sustained morale and protection into martial encounters.

classes.name: Archmage
classes.description: A prestige arcane expert who advances an established spellcasting tradition and chooses powerful force or warding techniques. Access requires genuine advanced spellcasting.

classes.name: Metamind
classes.description: A prestige psychic master who deliberately converts a finite reserve into recovered power points. Excels at sustaining a long series of decisions, not infinite casting.

classes.name: Duskblade
classes.description: An intelligence-based warrior-mage who delivers a chosen known spell through an equipped melee weapon. Even a missed attack consumes the action and spell slot.

classes.name: Spirit Shaman
classes.description: A spirit-focused nature caster who retrieves a limited spell selection after genuine home rest. Combines Wisdom-based magic with chosen guides and finite spiritual favour.

classes.name: Abjurant Champion
classes.description: A prestige martial caster who advances an existing arcane tradition while choosing a protective aegis or retaliatory technique. Powerful defences remain action- and resource-bound.

classes.name: Grove Warden
classes.description: A prestige nature protector who advances an existing nature caster, maintains a nearby sanctuary and spends finite favour renewing allies. Focuses on local protection rather than wilderness travel simulation.
